title: Password-Protected Admin System with Delete Poetry Feature

requirements.text: Add a fixed admin password stored securely in the backend. Expose a backend function that accepts a password string and returns a session token (or boolean) indicating admin access. All admin-only operations (add, edit, delete poem, manage collections) must verify admin authorization before executing.

quotes: jo password daale sirf wahi access pa sake
Poetry add karna, edit karna, collection banana — sirf aapke liye (password se protected)

acceptanceCriteria: A hardcoded or configurable admin password exists in the backend.
A verifyAdminPassword(password: Text) : Bool (or equivalent) function is exposed.
Add, edit, delete poem, and collection management functions reject calls that are not from an authenticated admin session.
Public read, download, and reaction functions remain unrestricted.

requirements.text: Add a deletePoem backend function that removes a poem (and its associated blob/image data) by ID. This function must only succeed when called by an authenticated admin.

quotes: delete ka button bhi add karo taqi uploaded poetry ko delete bhi kar sake

acceptanceCriteria: deletePoem(id: PoemId) function exists and removes the poem from storage.
Associated image blob data is also deleted if present.
Non-admin callers receive an authorization error.
After deletion, the poem no longer appears in poem listings.

requirements.text: Add an admin login UI: a modal or dedicated login page with a password input field. On successful password verification, store the admin session token/flag in localStorage or sessionStorage so the admin remains logged in across page refreshes within the session. Provide a logout option to clear admin access.

quotes: koi password wala system bana taqi jo password daale sirf wahi access pa sake

acceptanceCriteria: A password input modal or page is accessible from the header/navigation.
Correct password grants admin mode; wrong password shows an error message.
Admin session persists across page refreshes within the browser session.
A logout/exit admin mode button is visible when admin is logged in.
Admin mode indicator is shown in the UI (e.g., a badge or label in the header).

requirements.text: Restrict all admin UI controls (Add Poem button, Edit button, Collection Manager create/delete actions, Admin Panel page) so they are only visible and accessible when the user is in admin mode (password authenticated). Public users must not see or be able to interact with these controls.

quotes: abhi poetry add karna edit karna collection banana public access pe chal raha hai lekin mujhe hi sirf access chahiye
Baaki sab — sirf read, download, aur reaction de sakte hain

acceptanceCriteria: Add Poem navigation link/button is hidden from non-admin users.
Edit buttons on poems are hidden from non-admin users.
Collection create and delete controls are hidden from non-admin users.
Admin Panel page redirects or shows an access-denied message to non-admin users.
All admin routes are guarded and inaccessible without admin session.

requirements.text: Add a Delete button to each poem card and the poem detail page. The button must only be visible when the user is in admin mode. Clicking it shows a confirmation dialog before calling the deletePoem backend function. After successful deletion, the poem is removed from the list and the user is redirected to the home page if on the detail page.

quotes: delete ka button bhi add karo taqi uploaded poetry ko delete bhi kar sake
Delete button bhi hoga har poetry pe (sirf admin ko dikhega)

acceptanceCriteria: A Delete button appears on each PoemCard and on the PoemDetail page only when admin mode is active.
Clicking Delete opens a confirmation dialog (e.g., 'Are you sure you want to delete this poem?').
Confirming deletion calls deletePoem and invalidates the poem list cache.
The deleted poem is immediately removed from the home page grid.
If deleted from PoemDetail page, user is navigated back to home after deletion.
Non-admin users do not see the Delete button at all.

constraints: The admin password system must use a simple password check — no Internet Identity or external auth required for admin login.
Public read, download, and reaction features must remain fully accessible without any login.
Admin session state must be managed on the frontend (localStorage/sessionStorage); backend only verifies password per request.
Do not modify immutable frontend paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
nonGoals: Multi-user admin accounts or per-user admin roles.
Any changes to the existing poetry reading, download, or reaction features.
